title: Oz
blurb: The 1939 classic, a dark Disney sequel, a soul musical, a Disney prequel and Wicked, which tells the other side of Dorothy's story.

oz85.set: Six months after Dorothy's first trip

groups.title: Dorothy's adventures
groups.note: The 1939 film and Disney's unofficial sequel.

groups.title: The Wiz
groups.note: A soul musical retelling, set in a fantasy New York.

groups.title: Oz the Great and Powerful
groups.note: Disney's prequel about how the Wizard arrived.

groups.title: Wicked
groups.note: The witches' story, overlapping with Dorothy's.

note: These come from different studios and don't officially connect, but most people treat Oz the Great and Powerful and Wicked as prequels to the 1939 film. Return to Oz follows the books more than the MGM film, and is much darker than its reputation as a children's film suggests.
